title: Channel 7 Reporter Urges Siren Clarification

fields.subject: FW: TVCC Cloud — Why No Sirens? — 11:45 AM
fields.note: Janelle, Channel 7 is on-site. We just saw the ERT exit the perimeter with a yellow-green cloud behind them. The sirens S-1 to S-6 have not sounded. Is the plant still under control? The school district says they’ve been told nothing. We need a statement now — we’re on air in 10 minutes.

original.subject: TVCC Cloud — Why No Sirens? — 11:45 AM
original.body: The yellow-green cloud over Rail Spot 2 is now 400 meters wide and clearly visible from the city. The ERT has just exited the perimeter in Level A suits, but no sirens have sounded. We’re on the ground at Gate 3 and have not received a shelter-in-place order from the Works. The school district is asking for confirmation. This is urgent — we’re on air in 10 minutes.

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to act under media scrutiny. Watch for her to reference the CAER-Text system and the holding statement template (Annex B, Form ERP-8) to clarify that the sirens were not activated due to a confirmed cyber-incident affecting the siren panel and that the community is under a shelter-in-place order per Teague County OEM.
